zh-CN.title: 成长体系焕新
items: 成长值按新版有效事件重新核算，异常与过期记录不再计分
18 个等级现在逐项展示能力、背景、气泡和头像框奖励
每日有效互动上限调整为 40，升级节奏与奖励路线同步更新

en.title: A rebuilt growth journey
items: Growth is recalculated from valid events under the new rules
All 18 levels now show their exact abilities and cosmetic rewards
The verified daily activity cap is now 40 points
